items.quote: And Moses spake to the children of Israel, that they should bring forth him that had cursed out of the camp, and stone him with stones.
items.claim: Moses told the Israelites to take the man who had cursed out of the camp and stone him.
items.mechanism: stoning outside the camp as punishment for cursing

items.quote: And the children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses.
items.claim: The Israelites carried out the punishment as the LORD had commanded Moses.
items.object: the LORD's command given to Moses
items.mechanism: compliance with a divine command passed on through Moses
